correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the six halfspaces s>=0,t>=0,v>=0, Al-s-dt-Delta_A v>=0, bl-t-Delta_b v>=0, l-v>=0 with normal lengths 1,1,1,N_A,N_b,1. A radius rho ball is feasible only if all shifted facet margins hold. Since d,Delta_A,Delta_b>=0 and coordinate lower bounds require s,t,v>=rho, pushing to (rho,rho,rho) can only improve all three upper clearances. Feasibility reduces exactly to 2rho<=l, (1+Delta_b+N_b)rho<=bl, (1+d+Delta_A+N_A)rho<=Al. Gives the claimed min of three normalized barriers and the complete all-incenter six-inequality description. Verified allowed d=0 and equality/tie cases logically; an independent scipy linprog implementation sampled 250 integer parameter cases with zero observed discrepancy. Sampling corroborates, does not prove the all-integer symbolic theorem.
